categories.main_business_segments: JCET Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in semiconductor chip manufacturing and testing, offering comprehensive one-stop chip manufacturing services including system integration, design simulation, wafer testing, packaging, and final product testing. The company focuses on advanced packaging technologies such as wafer-level packaging, 2.5D/3D packaging, system-in-package (SiP), flip-chip, and traditional packaging solutions. Key application areas include communications, consumer electronics, computing, automotive electronics, industrial and medical electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor packaging and testing technologies including wafer-level packaging (WLP), 2.5D/3D packaging, system-in-package (SiP), flip-chip (FC), embedded wafer-level ball grid array (eWLB), and high-density fan-out (XDFOI®) packaging. It also utilizes high-reliability flat bump packaging (HFBP) and has capabilities in large-size FCBGA packaging. The production methods emphasize automation, intelligent manufacturing, and digital transformation to enhance quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: JCET serves a diversified global customer base including integrated circuit manufacturers, fabless companies, and foundries. Its products are widely applied in communications, high-performance computing (HPC), artificial intelligence (AI), automotive electronics, storage, 5G communications, industrial, and medical sectors. The company has strategic partnerships with leading international semiconductor firms and is integrated into core supply chains of automotive and high-end computing markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major production bases in China (Jiangyin, Shanghai, Chuzhou, Suqian), South Korea, and Singapore. It has over 20 business offices worldwide, serving customers across the Americas, Asia-Pacific, and Europe. The majority of revenue is generated from overseas markets, especially the United States, China mainland, and South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: JCET operates in the midstream to downstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in chip packaging and testing services. It receives wafers from foundries and fabless companies and provides integrated packaging, testing, and certification services before the chips are delivered to electronic device assemblers and end-product manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in advanced packaging technologies such as 2.5D/3D packaging, system-in-package (SiP), automotive-grade packaging, and high-density heterogeneous integration. It focuses on innovation in materials, process automation, AI-driven defect detection, and digital manufacturing platforms. Strategic initiatives include expanding automotive electronics capabilities, enhancing high-performance computing packaging, and developing next-generation packaging solutions to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: JCET generates revenue primarily through product sales of semiconductor packaging and testing services based on customer orders. It provides customized, end-to-end chip manufacturing solutions including design collaboration, packaging, testing, and logistics. Revenue is recognized upon fulfillment of contractual obligations, mainly at the point of product delivery or service completion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: JCET is ranked third globally among outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) providers and is the leading OSAT company in mainland China. It competes with other top OSAT firms from Taiwan, the US, and South Korea. The company holds a strong market position due to its advanced technology, diversified product portfolio, global footprint, and strategic partnerships with leading semiconductor companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, JCET achieved revenue of approximately RMB 35.96 billion, representing a 21.24% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 1.61 billion, up 9.44%. The company has shown steady growth driven by expansion in high-value markets such as automotive electronics and high-performance computing. Total assets reached RMB 54.06 billion, with a net asset value of RMB 27.62 billion, reflecting ongoing investments and acquisitions including an 80% stake acquisition in Shengdie Semiconductor.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JCET emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop chip manufacturing solutions, advanced and diversified packaging technologies, and strong global supply chain integration. Its competitive differentiation lies in its technological innovation in high-density and heterogeneous packaging, strong R&D capabilities, strategic customer partnerships, and ability to serve high-growth sectors like automotive electronics and AI computing. The company also highlights its commitment to quality, operational efficiency, and sustainable supply chain management.
